findings.title: New optional-dependency imports break clean base-profile test collection.
findings.observed: A fresh locked test-base environment without Kazoo/Gymnasium fails collection with two ModuleNotFoundError errors. No test body runs.
findings.required: Preserve clean base collection and useful behavioral tests without broad skips, adding runtime optional packages to base metadata, or weakening mandatory prerequisites. These tests already use a fake lock adapter and an action-space data contract; keep those contracts testable independently of optional packages, and retain actual-package qualification in the mandatory profile where relevant.
